title: RidgeFill paper final battery: one cell (one model x one battery part) on a rented box
$comment: Validated by finals/lib/cellcheck.py (a fail-closed mini-validator: every keyword here is implemented there; anything else is an error). Cell v2 (protocol 1.1, 2026-10-04). Reference-model cells (ruler, longbench, nll, decode, secondq, speed, mechanism) are lists of harness runs; finals/lib/kvabackend.py turns each (set, variant, model, tasks, lengths) group of runs into one scripts/evaluate.py config whose arms are kva.protocol.template() specs (protocol 1.1 rows by construction). Arm names are the paper's (protocol.json arm_aliases plus the v1.1 kinds, kvabackend PAPER); 'exact' runs in every harness run and is listed in every run. The flashnext cell (the engine tier, run by its own driver, not by kvabackend) declares arms, sets, split_layer, declared_share, positive_control and margins instead of runs. 'split' is the primary split (finals/tables.py reads it). Cells are written by finals/make_cells.py; registration is the FINAL- ledger id whose record pins the cell's and every config's sha256 (finals/register.sh).

dataset.$comment: optional: absent = the locked set (datasets/test-set-locked). A named frozen set replaces it (longppl only; on the box the directory of that name beside KVA_LOCKED_DIR); dataset_manifest_sha256 is then that set's MANIFEST.tsv sha256

$semantic.$comment: cross-field rules checked by cellcheck.semantic (not expressible in the schema subset)
$semantic.exact_in_every_run: every run lists 'exact' (the harness runs it in every config; it is every contrast's reference)
$semantic.run_ids_unique: run ids are unique within a cell (they name the harness configs)
$semantic.primary_run: a reference cell has a run with role 'primary' at its split (3/8); split is '3/8' and tail 4096 for reference cells
$semantic.swiftkv_runs: arms 'swiftkv' / 'swiftkv-native' only in runs with model 'swiftkv', which list nothing else but 'exact', and need 'swiftkv_model' and a llama model
$semantic.controls_need_their_rows_arm: identity+random / identity+tailmatch need identity+rows in the same run; ridgefill+random / ridgefill+tailmatch need ridgefill+rows
$semantic.qblind_at_the_blind_split: the qblind arms run at 3/8 only (protocol.json blind_splits)
$semantic.tailbudget_declared: arm 'nofill+tailbudget' needs 'tailbudget' (b, and how it was computed)
$semantic.ridgefill_requires_projector: any ridgefill arm (and kvexact) needs 'projector' with its provenance
$semantic.set_blocks: a longppl run needs 'keytoken'; a decode run 'decode'; a multiturn run 'secondq' and derived 'ruler-twokey'; a qfirst run (set ruler) derived 'ruler-qfirst'
$semantic.dataset_longppl_only: a cell with 'dataset' is an nll or nll-causal cell whose runs are all set longppl (the other sets exist on the locked set only)
$semantic.final_tbd_flagged: registration 'FINAL-TBD' is a warning: not registered yet, run_final.sh refuses it
$semantic.flashnext_cell: kind flashnext: no runs; split '-', split_layer, arms, sets, declared_share, positive_control and margins with all four keys; reference cells declare none of these
$semantic.row_selection: tasks / lengths only on ruler runs (lengths also on multiturn runs); no length over max_len
$semantic.projector_unpinned: a projector file without sha256 is a WARNING: the cell cannot be registered or run until the clean refit's sha256 is declared (make_cells.py reads it from the clean fit report)
